acceptance_criteria.statement: A Task can record whether it is judged to be two days or less of pre-AI work.
A Plan's Tasks with no such judgment, or judged larger, are identified as such on the Plan's page.

content.statement: As an architect, I can record my confidence that each Task would have taken two days or less before AI, so anything not yet well understood stands out before work starts.
content.title: Know each Task is small enough to be well understood

state.reason: Verified against the code and tests on 2026-11-02. A Task records its sizing, and the Tasks view names those unsized or judged larger.
